title: Campaign
details: Based on delivery KPIs and team outcomes

sections.title: About the Role
blocks: At House of Marketers, we help global brands grow through **high-performing influencer marketing campaigns** across multiple markets and platforms. As we continue to scale, our **pod-based structure** keeps account ownership, delivery, and commercial growth close together — and this role is one of its four core seats.

The Campaign Manager **executes best-in-class influencer campaigns end-to-end** — the person who makes the work ship. You own the coordination of multiple campaigns from setup through execution: balancing structure, communication, and problem-solving so **timelines are hit and nothing falls through the cracks.**

You are managed by a Senior Campaign Manager within Campaign Delivery, led by the Head of Delivery & Performance, and take your campaign priorities from the pod you’re aligned to. We’re looking for someone **organised, proactive, and excited by ownership** — who solves problems before they escalate.

list: Set up and manage campaigns in the project-management system with precision and timeliness
Coordinate day-to-day influencer communication (availability, deliverables, reminders)
Run quality assurance of influencer lists, briefs, contracts, and content
Ensure campaign timelines, usage rights, and deliverables are met
Take day-to-day campaign direction from the pod’s Account Manager / Account Director
Support prep for client calls, flag key updates, and document action points
Communicate with influencers professionally and on time
Keep the project-management system 100% up to date for full delivery visibility
Use established systems for capacity tracking, margin visibility, and outreach updates
Follow SOPs for consistent, error-free delivery
Escalate early: client / campaign risk → Account Manager; capacity, quality, or people issues → Senior Campaign Manager
Attend coaching and QA sessions and campaign debriefs run by Delivery
Complete structured onboarding and development milestones toward Senior CM

sections.title: Where the Role Sits
blocks: The Campaign Manager sits in **one pod** and works under two lines:

list: **Reports to (solid line): Senior Campaign Manager** — your manager for quality, coaching, and career
**Within Campaign Delivery: Head of Delivery & Performance → Senior Campaign Managers → Campaign Managers** — Delivery owns capacity and work allocation
**Takes direction from (dotted line): the pod’s Account Director / Account Manager** — for campaign priorities and client work

blocks: **You deliver the work; the pod decides what matters and Delivery sets how it is done.**

sections.title: What the Role Does Not Own

list: The client relationship — owned by the Account Manager
What’s most important / campaign priority — set by the pod (Account Director / Account Manager)
Your own capacity allocation and quality standards — owned by Delivery (Head of Delivery & Performance)
Retention, upsell, and commercial decisions — owned by the pod

items.title: Be proactive
blocks:
If something looks wrong, **investigate it before somebody asks you to.**

Do not wait for a problem to become an escalation.

items.title: Be intelligently curious
blocks:
Before asking someone else for the answer, **check.**

Look at the data. Speak to the right people. Test your assumptions. Understand what is actually happening.

Then **bring a recommendation, not just a question.**

items.title: Take ownership
blocks:
We do not want problems passed from person to person or department to department.

If you own something, **you stay close to it until there is a solution.**

items.title: Think from first principles
blocks:
If the same problem keeps happening, we do not want another checklist or temporary fix.

Understand why it is happening and **fix the root cause.**

items.title: Move fast
blocks:
Our industry changes constantly. Technology changes constantly. The company changes quickly.

You should be comfortable **testing new ideas, trying new tools, changing direction**, and **making decisions without waiting for perfect information.**

items.title: Use AI with judgement
blocks:
We use AI heavily, but **we do not want AI slop.**

AI should help you **think, analyse, automate, and move faster.** It should not result in endless generic documents, unnecessary documents, or reports nobody needs.

**Clear thinking comes first.**

list: Experience in digital marketing, influencer marketing, project coordination, creator economy, or agency delivery
Experience managing paid and non-paid influencer activations (PR gifting, seeding, ambassador programs) is a strong advantage
A systems thinker — comfortable with tech tools and structured workflows
Strong multitasking skills, with excellent attention to detail
Confident communicator in English, both written and spoken
A positive attitude and hunger to learn, improve, and contribute
AI fluency and operational system knowledge/comfort

sections.title: What Success Looks Like
blocks: You are doing this role well when:

list: Campaigns are delivered on time
The project-management system is 100% accurate and up to date
Campaign errors and escalations are minimal
You show initiative in solving campaign blockers before they escalate
Feedback from clients, teammates, and influencers is positive
You progress steadily toward Senior CM
